site: MOXIR hall, Charentsavan. Owner's pin 40.406524, 44.636560 (inside span 3).
what: The hall measured from above (OSM, Microsoft ML footprints, two Esri/Maxar captures). Layered AFTER moxir-hall-dims-2026-09-28/-09-29/-10-02 and moxir-site-2026-09-28; nothing in those files is edited. Method and sources: docs/moxir/AERIAL_2026-10-07.md; script scripts/place/aerial_measure.py.
frame: Image hall frame per capture: origin = OSM way 289841504 OBB centre, UTM 38N E 469134.28 N 4472953.73; u across (azimuth bearing-90, NE+), v along (azimuth = bearing_grid_deg, SE+), metres. Model frame: z = -(v - joint_v), x = nave_u - u.

length_m.how: roof edge to roof edge along the hall; 2020 capture 108.2 (outer SE edge; the inner SE edge gives 106.6, which the 09-28 session used), 2024 capture 108.25

width_m.how: roof edge to roof edge across; 97.34 in both captures

spans.how: lantern centres at roof centre -12.0 and +12.0 (= span 2 and 3 centres of a 4 x 24 grid within 0.1 m); a roof line at roof centre -36 (span 1 middle) in both captures; 97.3 = 4 x 24 + 1.3 m of walls

span_m.how: lantern centre to lantern centre 24.0; lantern NE edges 15.65 - (-8.33) = 23.98 (2020)

pitch_m.how: 2020 capture: FFT peak 5.96-6.02 m in four along-hall strips over spans 1 and 4; its phase is the same across 16 strips 3 m wide (Rayleigh R 0.85, p < 1e-4); the 12 m component is not phase-coherent (R 0.06). The 2024 capture is covered by solar arrays and gives no bay rhythm. The roof shows the roof module, not the columns: a 6 m module over 12 m columns cannot be told apart from above.

bays.how: 108.2 m roof = 18 x 6 + 0.2; 9 bays each side of the joint (the joint at 53.3 m from the NW roof edge, 54.9 m from the SE edge, both captures)

lantern_from_joint_m.how: 2020: joint line v 6.7; segment ends 46.3/5.1 (NW line side) and 6.35/47.7 (SE side), symmetric about the lantern-gap centre v 7.33 (+-5.7, +-47.0). 2024: NW ends 46.8 and 6.6 from its joint line. NW ends read at the sunlit lantern top after the cast shadow; SE ends from the NE shadow band + 2.2 m (shadow geometry).

bearing_true_deg.how: image grid bearing 144.33 / 144.23 by projection-profile deskew, converted with the meridian convergence (-0.24 deg here)

lantern_h_from_shadow_m.confidence: UNVALIDATED: the capture time is not in Esri's metadata; the sun azimuth is taken from the shadow direction itself and the elevation from the NOAA solar equations for 2020-10-30 at that azimuth. The 2024 capture gives 5.5 +- 1.0, read as PV panels on the lantern tops (SUSPECTED).

rows_u_offset_m.how: model as placed by moxir-site-2026-09-28 vs measured rows, 2020 frame
